EC1: Women of child-bearing potential, who are biologically able to conceive, [NOT] not employing two forms of highly effective contraception [OR] or who are pregnant.
EC3: Fertile males unwilling to use contraception
EC4: Patients with brain metastases [OR] or any history of brain metastases
EC5: Patients who have undergone major surgery [OR] (e.g., intra [OR]-thoracic, -abdominal, or -pelvic) </= 4 weeks prior to starting study treatment or who have [NOT] not recovered from such therapy
EC6: Patients with a history of pulmonary embolism [OR], or untreated deep vein thrombosis within the past 6 months
EC7: Impairment of gastrointestinal (GI) function [OR] or GI disease that may significantly alter the absorption of dovitinib
EC8: The subject has had another active malignancy within the past 5 years [NOT] except for cervical cancer in situ [OR], in situ carcinoma of the bladder [OR] or non-melanoma carcinoma of the skin.
EC9: Patients who have received the last administration of an anticancer therapy [OR] including chemotherapy [OR], immunotherapy [OR], hormonal therapy [OR] and monoclonal antibodies </= 2 weeks prior to starting the study drug, or who have not recovered from the side effects of such therapy
EC10: Cirrhosis [OR], chronic active hepatitis [OR] or chronic persistent hepatitis
EC11: Patients who are currently receiving prasugrel
EC12: [NOT] No concurrent use of isoniazid [OR], labetolol [OR], trovafloxacin [OR], tolcapone [OR], and felbamate
EC13: [NOT] No concurrent use of other investigational drugs [OR] or antineoplastic therapies.
EC14: Patients with impaired cardiac function [OR] or clinically significant cardiac diseases.
